steps.prompt: Create an image. Pixel art game VFX sprite sheet. The attached image is the LEVEL-1 version of a skill effect sheet of Thủy Giao (water). Redraw it as the LEVEL-2 (upgraded) version, FRAME FOR FRAME: a grid of 4 columns x 6 rows, the same order, every frame shows the same moment as the attached frame in the same cell, facing right, same pixel art style with a dark outline. Canvas portrait 2:3. Flat solid magenta background #FF00FF everywhere (no gradient, no shadow, no text, no numbers, no grid lines). Each effect stays inside its own cell and must not touch its neighbours. Level-2 rules: it must look COOL, POWERFUL and EPIC, like a boss-tier anime super move, not just the level-1 drawn bigger. Each effect is bigger than level 1 and covers a WIDER area, but it must stay fully inside its own cell with a clear magenta gap on every side (about one tenth of the cell): flames, trails, lightning and debris taper off and END inside the cell, never cut by the cell border and never reaching the neighbouring frame. Add crackling LIGHTNING BOLTS: THICK bold jagged electric arcs (thick enough to read even when the sprite is shown small) bursting out of and wrapping around every effect (white and electric cyan lightning), plus a raging energy aura, sharp shockwave rings, radial speed lines and strong white rim light with high contrast. Bigger impacts with ground cracks and debris thrown up. Draw it as big bold shapes with thick outlines and flat colour blocks, NOT tiny scattered particles or sparkle noise. Keep the blue, cyan, white foam colours and add gold rims and white shine, small golden dragon-scale motifs so it clearly reads as a much stronger tier. This sheet: skill 4 (ultimate) - Water dragon bigger with golden horns; water column taller and wider. LAYOUT OF THIS ONE IMAGE: rows alternate. Odd rows (1, 3, 5...) are the level-2 frames: row 1 = row 1 of the attached sheet, row 3 = its row 2, row 5 = its row 3, frame for frame, same order. Each EVEN row, right under a frame row, holds the IN-BETWEEN frames for smoother animation: the cell under a frame is the moment exactly HALFWAY between that frame and the NEXT frame, a new drawing halfway in size, position and lightning shape, not a copy. The 12 frames are ONE sequence read left to right, top to bottom: cell n = halfway from frame n to frame n+1 (cell 4 -> 5, cell 8 -> 9), cell 12 = frame 12 fading out a bit further. All cells the same size, every effect fully inside its own cell with a magenta gap, same place in its cell as the frame above it.
